title: Striatal dopamine synthesis in schizophrenia decreases from psychosis to psychotic remission
title_zh: 精神分裂症中纹状体多巴胺合成随精神病发作至精神病缓解的变化
abstract: Abstract Schizophrenia frequently follows a chronic relapsing-remitting course, comprising alternating episodes with and without psychotic symptoms (hereafter: psychosis and psychotic remission). One potential neurobiological correlate of this course is aberrant dopamine synthesis and storage (DSS) in the striatum, which can be estimated by the 18F-DOPA PET outcome kicer. We conducted a longitudinal study of state-related kicer changes in striatal subregions in medicated patients with multiple-episode schizophrenia. We hypothesized that striatal DSS in patients with schizophrenia decreases from psychosis to psychotic remission, with higher striatal DSS during psychosis and lower striatal DSS during psychotic remission, compared to healthy subjects. Additionally, we explored whether striatal DSS is associated with psychotic relapse after remission. 18F-DOPA PET scans and clinical assessments were conducted in 28 patients with schizophrenia at two time points, first during psychosis and second during early-to-moderate psychotic remission (6 weeks to 12 months after the first time point, 189 ± 80 days between-scan interval), as well as in 21 healthy controls, assessed twice in a comparable time interval. The averaged influx constant kicer of the striatal subregions nucleus accumbens, caudate and putamen was calculated as a proxy for DSS, using voxel-wise Gjedde–Patlak modelling with a cerebellar reference region. Mixed-effects models and post hoc analyses were used to test for longitudinal changes in kicer and cross-sectional group differences. An exploratory clinical follow-up 12 months after the second scan was conducted to assess psychotic relapse, and post hoc ANCOVAs were used to test for differences in kicer at each session between relapsing and non-relapsing patients. Patients’ kicer changes from psychosis to psychotic remission in caudate and nucleus accumbens differed significantly from assessments in healthy controls at comparable time points, with a significant longitudinal decrease of caudate kicer in patients. Furthermore, kicer in both caudate and nucleus accumbens was significantly lower in patients during early-to-moderate psychotic remission compared to controls, but no significant group difference was observed during psychosis. At the exploratory clinical follow-up, 32% of patients had experienced a psychotic relapse; they showed higher caudate kicer compared to non-relapsing patients during psychosis, with no difference during psychotic remission. These findings provide evidence for longitudinal changes of striatal, particularly caudate, DSS from psychosis to psychotic remission in medicated, multiple-episode schizophrenia patients, with lower caudate DSS during early-to-moderate psychotic remission but no aberrance during psychosis. The data indicate aberrant, fluctuating striatal dopamine synthesis across disorder states in schizophrenia.
abstract_zh: 摘要：精神分裂症常呈慢性反复发作的病程，交替出现有精神病症状与无精神病症状的阶段（以下简称精神病与精神病缓解）。该病程的潜在神经生物学关联之一是纹状体异常的多巴胺合成与储存（DSS），可通过18F-DOPA PET的kicer指标估算。我们对多发性发作精神分裂症患者进行纵向研究，评估其纹状体亚区的状态相关kicer变化。假设精神分裂症患者的纹状体DSS在精神病期高于健康对照，在精神病缓解期低于健康对照，并进一步探讨纹状体DSS是否与缓解后精神病复发相关。我们在28名精神分裂症患者中，在精神病期和早期至中期精神病缓解期（首次扫描后6周至12个月，扫描间隔平均189±80天）分别进行18F-DOPA PET扫描和临床评估，并在21名健康对照中在相似时间间隔内重复评估。使用小脑参考区的体素级Gjedde–Patlak模型计算纹状体亚区（伏隔核、尾状核和壳核）的平均kicer，作为DSS的代理。采用混合效应模型和事后分析检验kicer的纵向变化和跨组差异。我们在第二次扫描后12个月进行探索性临床随访，评估精神病复发，并使用事后ANCOVA检验复发与未复发患者在每个会话中的kicer差异。结果显示，患者在尾状核和伏隔核的kicer从精神病期到精神病缓解期的变化与健康对照在相同时间点的评估显著不同，且患者尾状核kicer呈显著纵向下降。进一步，尾状核和伏隔核的kicer在早期至中期精神病缓解期显著低于对照组，而在精神病期未观察到显著组间差异。在探索性随访中，32%的患者经历了精神病复发；这些患者在精神病期的尾状核kicer高于未复发患者，而在精神病缓解期无差异。以上发现提供了证据，表明在多发性发作、已用药治疗的精神分裂症患者中，纹状体（尤其是尾状核）的DSS在精神病期与精神病缓解期存在纵向变化，在早期至中期精神病缓解期尾状核DSS降低，但在精神病期无异常。数据表明，精神分裂症的纹状体多巴胺合成在不同疾病状态下呈异常波动。
